3. Zero Consumer Billing & Closed Imprint Policy

3. Free Public Web Properties, Fourthwall Merchant of Record & Closed Roster

Zero Consumer Subscriptions & Fourthwall Storefront

All *.raggiesoft.com web properties and The Listening Room are provided 100% free of charge ($0.00) with zero paid user accounts or subscriptions. All merchandise and digital album purchases on store.raggiesoft.com are processed by Fourthwall Inc. as the independent legal Merchant of Record under Fourthwall’s Terms and Refund Policy. Custom B2B commercial sync licenses are executed solely via written agreement.

Closed-System Roster & Anti-Impersonation Notice

Engine Room Records is a strictly closed private imprint; every band on our roster is an AI-assisted musical persona directed solely by Michael P. Ragsdale. We do not sign external artists, accept unsolicited demos, or recruit via third-party job boards or chat apps. Any unsolicited submissions sent to our domains are automatically deleted unread at the mail transport layer.
